doc.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023

title: A Stravinsky and Woody Herman digression that loses the thread
summary: Rowe raises Stravinsky's 'Ebony Concerto'; Broadbent can't recall what he meant to say and they move on.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: There’s an interesting anecdote about when Stravinsky wrote the “Ebony Concerto” for the Woody Herman band, and it was apparently quite the scene. And Chubby Jackson talked about like what is this — this does not groove. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
That’s right. Stravinsky. Yeah. Well. I was going to mention something but I can’t — what were we talking about just before that?
We were talking about your “Variations on a Scene.”
